page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre. Main text in one column on the left, with section number XXI at its start. Marginal notes in a narrow column at the right, beside the text. Page number at top right.

main_text.l: coram Deo judicentur. Nec dubito, quin
omnes, dummodo ex eorum quæ docentur ne-
cessitate ac usu & fructibus provenientibus
rem penfare volent, idem judicium facile sint
facturi.
XXI. At, at, a literis humanioribus re-
novatis, omnia renovata & polita audivimus.
Scilicet! Diabolus nimirum, qui antea feritat-
e aperta, ac crassa turpitudine tumultuose
sese prodebat; unde boni quique haud falsi,
in quiete ac sine rumore solide Deo sibique
agebant, ab inimico aperto facile cavent es;
is animarum hostis, jam Angeli lucis spe-
ciem vestemque ab eruditione mundana nac-
tus, sinceriores elegantiusque tutius sedu-
cit, dum pulso æternarum rerum ardore,
divinoque lumine intus prorsum extincto,
pro crassis terrestribusque vitiis, spiritualia,
proque externarum quarundam rerum, ple-
rumque inanium ignorantia, tenebras de rebus
internis & divinioribus horribiles, ideas cassas,
obscuras, chimiricas & futiles, errorum &
hæresels fontes, restituit; quæ omnia,
ipsamque cum vitiis quibusvis injustitiam, &
doctius proponere & subtilius defendere didi-
cit, vel adhibitis Scripturis ipsis per literatu-
ram suam versipellem ad quævis adaptatis: sic
ut errores perniciosissimi jam appareant veluti
veritates divinæ; vitia vero exitiosissima,
qualia amor sui, amor gloriæ, delectationum,
pecuniæ, rerum seculi, jactura temporis Deo
subducti, rixæ, odia interna, contemtus alio-
rum, simpliciorum irrisiones, rerum æter-
narum oblivio, imo & divinarum illusio,
jam

marginalia.note: Quartus prætextus, omnia ab iisdemmodi literis renovatis & polita esse, confutatur; & contrarium ostenditur.

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right are partly cut and faint; the transcription of the side notes is approximate. Some words in the text are doubtful, including "cavent es" and "versipellem", which are copied as printed.
